scorerRemediationRequirements: Coverage credit must require the matched candidate unit's own excerpt text to semantically support the SPECIFIC ground-truth claim, never merely its section-ref/descendant location - a chapeau/lead-in/flush-clause ground-truth unit must never be satisfiable by an unrelated numbered sub-clause beneath it.

When multiple candidate units match a location, do not silently select by highest-materiality rank; either require every candidate in the set to independently satisfy the content-correspondence check before crediting, or emit an explicit ambiguous-match finding instead of guessing.

Require a real-figure/defined-term/condition-type correspondence check (generalizing evaluator.ts's numbersMatch) unconditionally, including for qualitative provisions with no numeric figures, via a semantic/key-phrase similarity check between ground-truth description and candidate excerpt.

Every scoring run must persist the matched excerpt text alongside each credited case so a reviewer can re-verify correctness without re-running the pipeline - the exact discipline that made the 14-16/26 false-credit finding possible in the first place.

Any report publishing an aggregate coverage percentage computed by a scorer with this known, disclosed, unfixed defect must carry the caveat inline in that same report, not only in a separately-filed forensics document.
